SERVICES / BATHROOM PLUMBING

Bathroom Plumbing.

From fixture work to bathroom remodeling, Five Star RP provides bathroom plumbing services. Its project gallery includes a shower valve replacement.

When to get in touch.

  • A leaking shower valve or faucet
  • Toilet and sink plumbing issues
  • Plumbing changes during a bathroom remodel

Start with the details.

Describe the fixture, symptoms and any remodeling plans. For a renovation, discuss fixture placement and access to existing supply and drain connections before work begins.

A considered approach.

A bathroom fixture connects to a larger system. Compatible valves, sound connections and suitable drainage matter as much as the visible finish. Share product information if you have already selected new fixtures.

BEFORE YOU CALL

Estimates and availability.

How much does a typical plumbing service call cost?+

Our pricing varies depending on the type of service needed. We provide free estimates and upfront pricing before starting any work. There are no hidden fees or surprise charges. Contact us for a quote specific to your situation.

How quickly can you respond to a service call?+

For emergency calls, we aim to arrive within 60 minutes. For scheduled appointments, we offer same-day and next-day service in most cases. We'll always give you an accurate arrival time.
